description_en: Queries features that are not supported by a specified Smart Access Gateway (SAG) device
description_zh: 查询指定智能接入网关设备不支持的功能特性
kebab_example: aliyun smartag list-smart-ag-api-unsupported-feature --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --smart-ag-id sag-4d6i45zess8nj40000 --serial-number sage62x0526140000 --open-api-name ModifySagWan --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListSmartAGApiUnsupportedFeature

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the SAG instance is deployed
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关实例所属的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SAG instance with which the SAG device is associated
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关设备所属的智能接入网关实例ID
parameters.name: smart_ag_id

parameters.help_en: The serial number of the SAG device
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关设备序列号
parameters.name: serial_number

parameters.help_en: The API operation for the unsupported feature
parameters.name: open_api_name
